subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph in about 200 words on "A Rainy Day" answering the following questions:
stimulus: (a) How is a rainy day? (b) What can people do on this day? (c) How do the animals and birds pass this day? (d) What do the children do on this day? (e) What is the impact of the day on the poor and the rich?
